messages:
Priya (PM): Quick heads up — final release notes draft is ready for review. Target change window: Tue 03:00–05:00 UTC (EU overnight). Deploybot will start a 10% canary at 02:55 UTC. Need: legal signoff on the privacy blurb, ops standby, and final version pin.

deploy-bot: Canary job scheduled: release=v2.14.1, canary=10%, start=7162350900 (02:55 UTC), traffic-shift=gradual over 10m. Logs will post to #eng-runtime. Use `/deploy cancel <id>` to abort.

Alex (Eng): Copy looks good. Request: pin runtime image to `redwood/runtime:2026-03-15-gpu-3` in the RN so we don't get surprise kernel bumps during canary.

Priya (PM): Good call — adding image pin. Also adding a short rollback decision table to the RN. Draft below, plz 👇
```
Rollback triggers:
- Error rate spike: >3% 5xxs over baseline for 2 consecutive 1-min windows
- Latency regression: p95 increases by >200ms for 5m
- Canary failing healthchecks: >2 consecutive failed healthchecks
Rollback action: auto-fallback to previous model variant (v2.14.0) + paging oncall.
```

Jamal (Oncall): Clarify: do we autoscale down or immediately rollback on p95 threshold? My vote: alert first, then rollback at 10m if no mitigation. Keep alerting channel pinned.

Lina (SRE): Agreed with Jamal. Implement staged rollback: 1) alert + throttling (reduce burst to 50%), 2) if no improvement in 10m, full rollback. I'll add throttling rule to the canary policy.

Maya (Legal): Quick read done. Suggest tweak to privacy blurb: replace "may be logged" with "will be pseudonymized". Small language change only. Approved after that.

Priya (PM): Nice — updated RN text to use Maya's phrasing. Also adding internal announce snippet for #general and #customers (short version). Posting here for quick thumbs: 
- Internal (ops/dev): "Rolling v2.14.1 Tue 03:00–05:00 UTC. Expect brief canary at 02:55. Ops on standby; rollback plan in internal runbook."
- External (customers): "Planned maintenance Tue 03:00–05:00 UTC: minor improvements and stability fixes. No action required."

Alex (Eng): One more: include command for deploybot abort in RN so comms folks can see how we cancel. Eg `/deploy cancel 7162350900`

Priya (PM): Added example commands and the canary ID. Also added an ops contact roster for the window. Lina — can you confirm SRE standby rotation?

Lina (SRE): Confirmed. Oncall Jamal -> Lina backup -> Alex for infra escalations. I'm on standby 02:30–06:00 UTC. I'll post the rota to the runbook and pin it on the release thread.

Jamal (Oncall): I'll draft the short alert playbook snippet for p95 and 5xx thresholds and drop it in the runbook. Also, I'll set a synthetic check to run 10m before canary to baseline latency.

deploy-bot: Canary started at 7162350900. Initial healthchecks passing. Metrics endpoint: https://metrics.redwood.example/canary/7162350900

Priya (PM): Thanks — everyone, please give final +1s in the next 30m. If none, I'll send the internal announce and lock the RN. :white_check_mark: :rocket:

Alex (Eng): +1

Maya (Legal): +1 (from legal)

Lina (SRE): +1 — standby confirmed

Jamal (Oncall): +1 — will monitor
